_comment: The 03 §12 corpus and its run plan — the *inputs* to the golden hashes.
Kept separate from state.golden.json (the measured outputs) on purpose: a
`--update` run rewrites the outputs, and if the run length lived there too,
shortening a run would look exactly like a hash changing. Editing this file
is a deliberate act that re-keys the goldens.
§12 asks for 3600 steps per scene. A scene that reaches a §9.2 finish
condition first stops there, and its golden records that step — the finish
step is itself part of what determinism has to reproduce.
Coverage: 02's two worked examples, one scene carrying every catalog type
and every link type, and the four adversarial shapes §12 names (a domino
field at the object ceiling, 64-segment ropes, a meshed gear chain, all the
field types at once) plus the pulley rope, because §8.2 is the one piece of
solver mathematics this engine implements itself.
